name: 0gdrive
description: Private, encrypted file drive on 0G decentralized storage

scripts.build: npm run build -w @0gdrive/core && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w assistant
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @0gdrive/core && (npm run dev -w assistant & npm run dev -w web)
scripts.test:batch: npm run build -w core && node scripts/test-batch-upload.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w core && node scripts/test-browser-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:wallets: npm run build -w core && node scripts/test-wallet-picker.mjs
scripts.test:svg: npm run build -w core && node scripts/test-svg-thumbs.mjs
scripts.test:share-wallet: npm run build -w core && node scripts/test-share-wallet.mjs
scripts.test:password: npm run build -w core && node scripts/test-password-recovery.mjs
scripts.test:rename: npm run build -w core && node scripts/test-rename.mjs
